1use skrifa_047::GlyphId;
2use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
3use std::collections::HashMap;
4
5#[derive(Debug)]
6pub(crate) struct GlyphSimulator {
7    // We simulate that Type1 glyphs have glyph IDs so we can handle them transparently
8    // to OpenType fonts.
9    glyph_to_string: RefCell<HashMap<GlyphId, String>>,
10    string_to_glyph: RefCell<HashMap<String, GlyphId>>,
11    glyph_counter: Cell<u32>,
12}
13
14impl GlyphSimulator {
15    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
16        let mut glyph_to_string = HashMap::new();
17        glyph_to_string.insert(GlyphId::NOTDEF, "notdef".to_string());
18
19        let mut string_to_glyph = HashMap::new();
20        string_to_glyph.insert("notdef".to_string(), GlyphId::NOTDEF);
21
22        Self { glyph_to_string: RefCell::new(glyph_to_string), string_to_glyph: RefCell::new(string_to_glyph), glyph_counter: Cell::new(1) }
23    }
24
25    pub(crate) fn string_to_glyph(&self, string: &str) -> GlyphId {
26        if let Some(g) = self.string_to_glyph.borrow().get(string) {
27            *g
28        } else {
29            let gid = GlyphId::new(self.glyph_counter.get());
30            self.string_to_glyph.borrow_mut().insert(string.to_string(), gid);
31            self.glyph_to_string.borrow_mut().insert(gid, string.to_string());
32
33            self.glyph_counter.set(self.glyph_counter.get() + 1);
34
35            gid
36        }
37    }
38
39    pub(crate) fn glyph_to_string(&self, glyph: GlyphId) -> Option<String> {
40        self.glyph_to_string.borrow().get(&glyph).map(|s| s.to_string())
41    }
42}
